title: School page
description: A text page of the platform: help for students and teachers, FAQ, and the legal documents (privacy policy, offer, consents). Written as Markdown in content/school/pages/<page_id>.md with a short header between --- lines; the loader turns the file into this object. A legal page has a version: when it changes, students accept the new text on their next visit.

audience.description: Who finds the page in help. Legal pages are for all.

version.description: The date of the text's edition. Required for legal pages.

order.description: Place in the help list; lower comes first.
